summary: Aetherion Technologies Inc., a Vancouver-domiciled foreign private issuer listed on TSX and Nasdaq, furnished a Form 6-K containing a press release dated October 29, 2026, announcing it will report Q3 2026 financial results after market close on November 12, 2026, with a conference call and webcast on November 13, 2026 at 9:00 a.m. ET. No transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are disclosed. The filing is a routine earnings-scheduling notice, not a special situation; the only item to watch is any corporate development commentary on the November call.
